manifest.provenance: 100% synthetic. No external dataset was used; no personal or confidential data. City names are used only as warehouse labels.

evaluation.note: Detector uses only input tables; ground truth is read here, after the run, for scoring. Labels come from the same documented rules, so a perfect score shows the detector implements the rules correctly (time windows and thresholds are probed by the negative controls); it is not evidence of generalisation to unseen anomaly types.

warehouses.cardinality: 1 warehouse : N zones, N locations, N orders

zones.purpose: Storage zone per warehouse (one per type), laid out from the dock outward

aisle_blocks.purpose: Aisle closures with effective window (blocked_to empty = open-ended)

locations.purpose: Pick location (slot position) with physical capacity
locations.cardinality: 1 location : N slot assignments over time

compatibility_rules.purpose: Hazard classes that must not share a bay

skus.cardinality: 1 SKU : N profiles (versioned), N order lines

sku_profiles.purpose: Versioned physical + velocity profile (SCD type 2 by effective dates)
sku_profiles.cardinality: N profiles : 1 SKU; exactly one is_current

orders.purpose: Customer order picked at one warehouse (actor: carrier)
orders.cardinality: 1 order : N order lines, N pick events

order_lines.cardinality: N lines : 1 order; 1 line : 0..1 pick event

slot_assignments.purpose: Bridge SKU x Location over time (N:M with history). Never overwritten: moves RELEASE the old row and create a new one

pick_events.purpose: Executed pick in S-shape route sequence

replenishments.purpose: Reserve -> forward-slot replenishment task per SKU per shift

labour_roster.purpose: Replenishment team capacity per warehouse shift
